overview: The City Council approved the 2025 Hazard Mitigation Plan and adjusted the Tree Warden position, though it tabled a $250,000 funding request for the Affordable Housing Trust pending a broader review of year-end free cash expenditures.

items.title: Condolences for Mimi Gordon
items.summary: Approved a resolution offering condolences to the family of Mimi Gordon and commemorating her long service as a community activist, union representative, and local political organizer.

items.title: First Responder and Veteran Recovery Group
items.summary: Approved a resolution promoting a new weekly recovery meeting for first responders and veterans dealing with substance use and mental health disorders.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved various committee records and reports, including preliminary budget presentations and a report on the Citizen Control over Public Surveillance ordinance.

items.title: Amendments to Welcoming City Ordinance
items.summary: Referred proposed amendments addressing potential loopholes in information transmission to the Committee on Public Health and Community Safety.

items.title: Urban Forestry Management Plan Recommendations
items.summary: Referred recommendations from the recently finalized Urban Forestry Management Plan to the Public Works and Facilities Committee for legislative and budgetary analysis.

items.title: Hearing on Fractional Zoning Amendments
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on proposed zoning amendments for fractional units to July 14th to allow staff to identify new valuation benchmarks.

items.title: Free Cash Appropriation for Affordable Housing Trust
items.summary: Tabled a request for a $250,000 appropriation to the Affordable Housing Trust. Members expressed support for the trust but preferred to consider the request alongside other year-end free cash expenditures and the upcoming budget cycle.

items.title: Auto Sales and Repair Licenses
items.summary: Approved Class 1 and Class 4 licenses for Herb Chambers Toyota following their relocation to 400 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Do Not Knock Registry Amendments
items.summary: Referred an ordinance amendment to modernize the Do Not Knock registry, update fine structures, and clarify background check procedures to the Subcommittee on Licensing Permitting and Signs.

items.title: Routine Appointments and Donations
items.summary: Approved appointments to the Community Garden Commission, Affordable Housing Trust, and Zoning Board of Appeals, along with a $1,000 donation from Stop and Shop for DEI initiatives.

items.title: Hazard Mitigation Plan 2025 Update
items.summary: Approved the updated Hazard Mitigation Plan, which identifies risks from flooding and extreme weather and enables the city to access federal mitigation grant funding through 2030.

items.title: Tree Warden Personnel Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: Approved an amendment to increase the pay grade for the Tree Warden and transition the role to a 40-hour-per-week position to lead the Forestry Division.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident spoke concerning the city's response to federal immigration enforcement and requested greater public recognition of and protection against Islamophobia.
